description: Error, Null and failing-expression values through ACE: for each of 21 expressions (CVErr with several codes, IsError, Null arithmetic, division by zero, bad conversions, Chr(0), Nz), SELECT expr AS V FROM One read (Field Type and Value), then TypeName and VarType. Asks the VARIANT tag (VT_ERROR, VT_NULL, ...), the SCODE or value, and which statements fail to open or to read, with the error.

SELECT TypeName(CVErr(2007)) AS TN, VarType(CVErr(2007)) AS VT FROM One
